routes.label: the ordinary electronic passport in Bogotá: the Ministry's fee and the national stamp tax
the ordinary electronic passport at a consulate outside the euro zone and Cuba

note: The Ministry's fee for an ordinary electronic passport is COP 116,600 from Resolución 03969 of 2026 (in force from the day after its publication on 31 March 2026); the national stamp tax for 2026 is COP 79,000 (1.5 UVT), as the Gobernación de Antioquia's resolution of 30 December 2025 records the DIAN's figure. The departments' offices add their own charges (Antioquia's first payment is COP 199,000 in all), which aren't modelled: the game prices the passport as in Bogotá. Abroad the fee is EUR 63 (euro zone and Cuba) or USD 86 (the rest of the world): the abroad route carries the dollar fee, the one abroad currency the form holds; the euro fee isn't held. Validity and processing time are leads.

sources.said: ARTÍCULO 3o. TARIFAS PARA LA EXPEDICIÓN DE PASAPORTES. El valor de expedición de pasaportes se determinará de la siguiente forma: 3.1.
